يقتضبون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَضِبُونَ (yaqtaḍibūna) /jaq.ta.dˤi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# يُقْتَضَبُونَ (yuqtaḍabūna) /juq.ta.dˤa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
